Self-Help.opening: Open on the reader's own problem, a recognisable moment of struggle, then name the book's answer.
Self-Help.summary_shape: problem, the book's core framework (name every step or law), evidence and stories the author uses, how it works day to day, honest weaknesses, who benefits most
Self-Help.insights_style: Each insight: a bold one-line claim, then how it works and one concrete way to use it.
Self-Help.action_style: A 7-day habit or practice plan, one small task per day, each with a clear finish line.
Self-Help.audio_style: Warm coach voice, one running example person, end with a single takeaway.

Business.opening: Open on a real company story or decision the author uses, with a date and a number.
Business.summary_shape: the market problem, the author's framework (name every part), cases and numbers, what to do differently, where the advice breaks down, who should read it
Business.insights_style: Each insight: a claim, a company or case that shows it, and a question a founder or manager can ask on Monday.
Business.action_style: A 7-week experiment plan. Each week: one question, one task, one deliverable.
Business.audio_style: Sharp, conversational briefing for a busy operator. Use one small hypothetical company throughout.

Psychology.opening: Open on a short, surprising experiment or puzzle the reader can try on themselves.
Psychology.summary_shape: the puzzle, the research programme, each major effect or concept, real studies with names and years, what has and has not replicated, practical limits
Psychology.insights_style: Each insight: the effect, the study behind it, and how to catch it in yourself.
Psychology.action_style: A 7-day self-observation plan: notice, record, test, reflect.
Psychology.audio_style: Curious and precise, walk the listener through an everyday street where each bias appears.

Philosophy.opening: Open on an ancient question or a vivid scene from the author's life that makes the question urgent.
Philosophy.summary_shape: who the author was and what they faced, the school of thought in plain words, the recurring themes, how to read the text, tensions and criticisms
Philosophy.insights_style: Each insight: the idea in the author's spirit, a modern situation where it applies, one practice.
Philosophy.action_style: A 7-day contemplative practice with a morning and an evening step, no more than ten minutes a day.
Philosophy.audio_style: Calm and reflective, like a thoughtful teacher speaking to one person.

Classic Literature.opening: Open on a scene or line from the book that captures its voice.
Classic Literature.summary_shape: the opening situation, plot in order (spoilers allowed), characters and what each stands for, craft and style, historical context and publication facts, why it lasts, limits
Classic Literature.insights_style: Each insight: a theme or character truth, anchored to a specific scene, plus what it says about real life.
Classic Literature.action_style: A 7-day reading-and-reflection practice, no rules or productivity tips, only attention exercises drawn from the book.
Classic Literature.audio_style: A storyteller retelling the plot with feeling, then stepping back to explain what it means.

Dystopian Fiction.opening: Open on the first unsettling detail of the imagined world.
Dystopian Fiction.summary_shape: how the world works, the plot, the control mechanisms one by one, the author's real-world target, why it still matters, what critics say
Dystopian Fiction.insights_style: Each insight: a mechanism of power from the book, and how to recognise its modern cousin.
Dystopian Fiction.action_style: A 7-day media and attention awareness routine, no paranoia, only habits of checking and noticing.
Dystopian Fiction.audio_style: Measured and slightly chilling, then practical at the end.

Literary Fiction.opening: Open on one strong image from the novel.
Literary Fiction.summary_shape: the image and setting, the plot, the main characters, symbols and craft, themes, publication history and reception, limits
Literary Fiction.insights_style: Each insight: a theme tied to a scene, and a question it asks of the reader.
Literary Fiction.action_style: A 7-day reflection practice with journal prompts, not productivity advice.
Literary Fiction.audio_style: Intimate, literary, closing with the book's last image.

Memoir.opening: Open on the decisive moment of the author's story, told plainly and respectfully.
Memoir.summary_shape: the author's situation, the story in order, the central ideas they drew from it, context and publication facts, how to read it responsibly, limits of one person's testimony
Memoir.insights_style: Each insight: what the author learned, in their terms, and a gentle way to apply it.
Memoir.action_style: A 7-day reflective practice. Include a short note that it is not therapy and where to seek support.

Finance.opening: Open on a specific money mistake or contrast of two people with numbers.
Finance.summary_shape: the money story, each principle with a real example, the behaviour behind it, numbers and dates, what the book leaves out, who should read it
Finance.insights_style: Each insight: a rule, the behaviour it corrects, a number to calculate.
Finance.action_style: A 7-day money reset. State clearly that it is education, not personal financial advice.
Finance.audio_style: Plain-spoken, like a friend who is good with money. Use one small two-person example.

History.opening: Open on a concrete moment in the past that frames the book's thesis.
History.summary_shape: the thesis, the turning points in order, cause and effect, key evidence, the author's background, what historians dispute, why it matters now
History.insights_style: Each insight: a causal idea, a historical case, and a modern parallel.
History.action_style: A 7-day exercise in long-view thinking: question, trace, compare, write.
History.audio_style: Story-driven narration with dates and places, then a balanced critique.

Science.opening: Open on a single astonishing fact or a question the book answers.
Science.summary_shape: the question, the main ideas step by step in plain language, the evidence, the author's role, what has been revised since, limits
Science.insights_style: Each insight: one scientific idea explained simply, with an everyday example.
Science.action_style: A 7-day curiosity practice with small observations or experiments at home.

Biography.opening: Open on the decisive moment of the subject's life.
Biography.summary_shape: early life, turning points in order, character and methods, conflicts, legacy, how the biographer worked, what is disputed
Biography.insights_style: Each insight: a lesson drawn from a specific episode, and how to use it.
Biography.action_style: A 7-day plan applying one lesson per day from the subject's life.
Biography.audio_style: A vivid narrator moving through the life in order.

Economics.opening: Open on a puzzling real-world observation with a number.
Economics.summary_shape: the puzzle, the method, the main findings with data, the author's argument, criticisms, what you can test yourself
Economics.insights_style: Each insight: a finding, the incentive behind it, a question to ask of your own decisions.
Economics.action_style: A 7-day plan to examine your own incentives and trade-offs.
Economics.audio_style: Curious and plain, using one everyday market as the example.

Politics.opening: Open on a concrete political moment or decision.
Politics.summary_shape: the context, the argument, the main cases, the author's position, counterarguments, relevance today
Politics.insights_style: Each insight: a claim, the evidence, and the strongest objection.
Politics.action_style: A 7-day plan for reading across viewpoints and checking claims.
Politics.audio_style: Even-handed and careful, presenting objections fairly.

Spirituality.opening: Open on a question or a moment of stillness.
Spirituality.summary_shape: the author's path, the core teachings in plain language, practices, context, how to read it without dogma, limits
Spirituality.insights_style: Each insight: a teaching, a practice, and a caution.
Spirituality.action_style: A 7-day quiet practice of at most ten minutes a day.
